name: com.rotteneagle.audioreactive
description: Minimal low-latency audio-reactive toolkit in the spirit of LASP: native WASAPI capture of the system output (loopback) or any input device, a band-filtered level tracker with onset detection, a log / octave spectrum analyzer, property binders, live inspector meters and VFX Graph property binders. This release ships the native plugin for Windows x64 only.

samples.description: One Audio Level Tracker scaling a sphere with a Vector3 binder; the starting point. URP.
Low / Mid / High trackers with LowPass, BandPass and HighPass filters; onset envelope flash and the On Onset event. URP.
Every binder type (Float, Vector3, Euler Rotation, Color, Material Float, Material Color) on lights, transforms and materials. URP.
Spectrum Analyzer read from code (octave bars) and as a texture in a shader (log band bars). URP.
Audio Level, Audio Spectrum and Audio Waveform VFX Property Binders driving three small effects. Requires Visual Effect Graph and URP.
